_readme: All 13 Ethiopian months' FIXED daily readings below are populated from real source data, covering every day supplied. Meskerem, Tikimt, Hidar, Tahsas, Tir, Yekatit, Megabit, Miazia, Ginbot, and Sene have all 30 days filled. Hamle and Nehase currently include only the specific feast days that were supplied (not every day of those two months has an entry yet) — add more '<monthId>-<day>' keys the same way to fill in the rest. Pagume has all 6 days (day 6 only applies in leap years, flagged with is_leap_year_only). The 'movable' section (for Abiy Tsom / Himamat / Tinsae season-wide readings) is intentionally empty for now since no real data was provided for it — the site still works fine without it, falling back to each day's specific fixed entry, which already exists for most of Great Lent/Holy Week/Easter via Yekatit/Megabit/Miazia. Add entries here only if your tradition uses a single season-wide reading instead of (or as an override for) specific daily ones.

11-19.psalm_text_amharic: ቃሉን የምትፈጽሙ ኃያላን ብርቱዎች ቃሉንም የምትሰሙ መላእክቱ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ።

11-24.psalm_text_amharic: ጻድቅ እንደ ዘላበደ ያበባል እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ያድጋል።

12-7.psalm_text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሰማዮች ፀኑ ሠራዊታቸውም ሁሉ በአፉ እስትንፋስ።

12-13.psalm_text_amharic: ታቦርና አርሞንኤም በስምህ ይደሰታሉ፤ ክንድህ ከኃይል ጋር ነው።

12-16.psalm_text_amharic: አምላክ ወደ ዕረፍትህ ተነሥ፤ አንተና የቅድስናህ ታቦት።

12-24.psalm_text_amharic: ጻድቅ እንደ ዘላበደ ያበባል እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ያድጋል።

13-1.commemoration: St. John the Baptist / Angel Uriel
13-1.psalm_text_amharic: ቅዱሳን በክብር ይመካሉ በብርሃናቸውም ላይ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

13-2.psalm_text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በቅዱሳኑ ላይ ድንቅ ነው፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ ኃይልንና ብርታትን ለሕዝቡ ይሰጣል።

13-3.psalm_text_amharic: ቃሉን የምትፈጽሙ ኃያላን ብርቱዎች ቃሉንም የምትሰሙ መላእክቱ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ።

13-4.psalm_text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ማለ አይጸጸትም፤ አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ።

13-5.psalm_text_amharic: በበጎነትህ ዓመትን ታጎናጽፋለህ ምድረ በዳውም ስብን ይሞላል።

13-6.psalm_text_amharic: እነሆ አበቃቅን አስተምረን፤ ጥበብንም ያዘዘ ልብን እናመጣለን።
